transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

Um... well. I guess I just haven't been doing much lately. The things that usually make me feel like myself... like my photography walks, or mentoring the kids... even just keeping a clean calendar. It all just started feeling... flat. Kind of heavy, I guess. I just stopped initiating them. So... I thought I should come in.
How long have you been feeling this flat and heavy?

Um... I'd say... maybe a year and three months? Give or take. It kind of started around the time... well, a family member had some health issues. Their behavior changed, and I had to step in and start coordinating a lot of things for them. So... since about then, I guess.
During this past year, have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day on more days than not?
Um... I don't really know if I'd use the word depressed. I wouldn't say that. Just... like I said, flat. I still get through the days fine. So... no, I don't think so.
Do you feel these changes began because of the stress of managing your family member’s health problems?

Um... I'm really not sure. I guess it's possible. 

I mean, I organize things for a living, so... I didn't feel particularly stressed by it. It's just... that's around the time I noticed it. I couldn't really tell you if one caused the other.
Over this past year, have you often felt hopeless?
No. Not really. I just... I just feel flat. That's all.
Has a doctor told you that you have any medical condition that could be affecting your mood or energy?
No, um... I haven't been to a doctor for anything like that. So, no.
Over this past year, have you often felt badly about yourself?
No... I wouldn't say that. I don't really think about it like that.
During this past year, was there ever a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
No... I don't think so. Not like that.
Over the past year, have you often felt tired or low on energy?
No... not really. My energy is fine, I guess. Nothing out of the ordinary.
Do you feel your flat mood is mainly because of what has been happening with your family member?
I don't really... I wouldn't call my mood flat. And I'd rather not get into the family stuff. I don't think it has anything to do with anything, anyway.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in the things you usually enjoy?

I guess... yeah. That's sort of what made me come in. Just... things that usually make me feel like myself, they started feeling kind of flat. And heavy. Like my photography walks, or... mentoring the kids. Even just keeping a clean calendar. I just... I stopped initiating them. I don't really know why.
Have you felt this loss of interest most days for at least two years?
No... I don't think it's been two years. Not that long. Just... more recently, I guess.
During this past year, have you lost interest in things most of the day nearly every day?
I don't know about every day. I mean... I still go to work and get things done. I wouldn't say it's all day, every day. Just... sometimes.
Over the past year, have you often felt anxious or worried?
I don't think so. Not really anxious, no. Just... maybe a little stressed sometimes, but not worried.
At any point in the past year, was there ever a period of at least two weeks when you lost interest in almost everything nearly every day?
No... I don't think so. Not for two whole weeks straight. Like I said, I... I still have to go to work and get things done, so... no. It hasn't been like that.
Did these changes start within about three months of your family member’s health problems beginning?
I'm not sure what you mean. No one in my family has had any health problems. So... no.
Before this past year, was there ever another time in your life when you had a similar period of losing interest in the things you usually enjoy?
No, I... I can't recall anything like that. I've always just... kept busy. So, no.
During this past year, have there been stretches when you felt sad most of the day on most days?
No... not really. I don't think I've felt sad like that. Just... normal, I guess.
Has this change in your interest in things been causing you significant distress or problems in your daily life?

Not... significant problems, I guess. Work is mostly fine. I've just missed a few calendar details here and there, so I have to double-check tasks that used to be automatic for me. And... I guess I've pulled back from my photography outings. And the mentoring I do. I just don't feel as present or reliable right now, so... I just haven't been doing them.
Around the time this change started, was there a specific stressful event in your life?

I guess... yeah. It's been about a year and three months now. Um... a family member of mine, their health changed. And their behavior. I had to step in and take on more of the coordination for them, so... I suppose that was happening around when this started.
